notes.title: Another bug-fix patch is live!
notes.content:
v1.0.3

- Fixed ability to fire charged bullet without collecting powerup.
- Added new supported keyboard keys in dialog message.
- Added support for AZERTY keyboards.
- Fixed an issue where level 16 was shown locked even though it was unlocked.
- Fixed issues in levels 16, 17 and 18.

notes.title: Bug-fix patch is live
notes.content:
A small patch to fix minor issues is now live.

- Fixed the ability to dash without collecting the required powerup.
- Added ability to fire with the 'Y' key as well to support QWERTZ keyboards
- Fixed alignment issues for dialogs
- Fixed issues in level 2 and level 4
